en.title: Count Numbers with Even Number of Digits
en.description:
Given an integer array nums, count the elements whose decimal representation has an even number of digits. The decimal representation of 0 has one digit.

The parts of the input protocol and constraint ranges marked "this site's supplement" were prepared by this site and are not extra conditions of the original problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤100000), and the second line contains n integers (0≤nums[i]≤10^9). The length and value constraints are common ranges adopted by this site; digit counts are based on the decimal representation.
en.output: Output the number of elements with an even number of digits.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the rules above; see the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First pin down the problem's definition of counting/path/splitting, then choose a suitable graph traversal, frequency counting, or dynamic programming.
